name: corn
_note: also the seed for the corn field

log: Hard, starchy kernels. You chew a long time.
Raw corn, tough and faintly sweet.
You gnaw the kernels off the cob.

actions.label: roast
log: You roast the ear in the embers until the kernels split.
The husk blackens; the kernels inside go gold.
Corn in the embers, turned until it smells sweet.
